description: A jolt of caffeine. Sharpens you up for a while.

overdose.message: Your heart skips and seizes. Too much caffeine, too fast. Your chest goes tight and you fall.

comedown_message: The lift goes out of it. You could do with another.
The edge comes off, and the tiredness it was covering is still there.
It's worn off, and you're worse off than before.
phases.comeup_message: The first mouthful burns. You don't feel it yet.
phases.end_message: It's worn off, and you're more tired than when you started.
peak_message: The caffeine kicks in. You feel more awake.

withdrawal.message: You've got a throbbing headache, and the light hurts your eyes.

stages.easing: The headache fades, leaving a dull spot in the middle.
stages.onset: A dull pressure starts behind one eye.
stages.peak: Light hurts, noise hurts, and you've read the same line four times without taking it in.
stages.rising: It's a proper headache now, throbbing in time with your pulse.
stages.tail: You're fine, but you wake up later than you used to and you're useless until lunch.

name: coffee
